title: Leorios Defiance and the Fishing Rod — Part 4

series.summary: Kurapika urges Leorio to flee, but Leorio refuses to run from a monster and attacks Hisoka with a wooden club. Just as Hisoka readies a fatal counter, Gon's fishing rod strikes Hisoka square in the face from above.

segments.voiceover_text: Kurapika whispers a desperate strategy to Leorio. Knowing fighting this monster is suicide, they must sprint in opposite directions to divide Hisoka's focus.
Kurapika dashes into the trees, but Leorio stops dead. Grabbing a heavy wooden branch, his pride boils over—refusing to run like a coward from a killer.
Leorio roars and charges Hisoka with everything he has. But Hisoka effortlessly slips past the strike, vanishing into the fog to deliver a lethal counter.
Right before Hisoka delivers the fatal blow, a fishing bobber whips through the mist! Gon's weighted hook smashes squarely into Hisoka's face, staggering the magician.
